text: Home lists Context, Project, Local, Global and the Library.
Context shows every file Claude loads, in order, and why.
Rules that load only for matching paths are called out.
Press → to compare runtimes. Codex loads a different chain.
CLAUDE.md is built from Sections; one is shared with AGENTS.md.
Ask your coding agent. It edits the Section through the CLI.
The TUI reloads from disk while the agent works.
Review the difference. Nothing has been applied yet.
AGENTS.md gets the same line: both targets share the Section.
Authorize Apply. The difference closes on its own.
